name: us-stock-analysis
description: US stock fundamental & technical analysis toolkit

scripts.lint:json: for f in InvestSkill/plugins/us-stock-analysis/.claude-plugin/plugin.json InvestSkill/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json; do jq empty "$f" && echo "✅ $f"; done && node -e "const a=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('InvestSkill/plugins/us-stock-analysis/.claude-plugin/plugin.json')).version,b=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('InvestSkill/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json')).metadata.version;if(a!==b){console.error('❌ Version mismatch: plugin='+a+' marketplace='+b);process.exit(1)}console.log('✅ Versions match: '+a)"
scripts.pre-release: npm test && node scripts/setup-verify.js && npm run lint:json && echo '\n✅ Pre-release checks passed'
